source.title: Sprint 12 — MAKHEX Doroppu test import readback, N4 mismatch, and supplier qualification
source.body:
## Status (2026-10-22)
**MAKHEX × Doroppu real Squarespace import: controlled staging succeeded; products are not approved for sale.**

### Verified in authenticated Squarespace admin
- Squarespace product catalog was **8** existing hidden/demo products at initial export `products_Oct-22_09-35-12AM.csv`.
- First live test: AliExpress item `1005009494694247` imported as hidden/stock **0** using verified existing Squarespace Store Page slug `support` and the account's **28-column `product_import-v3.csv`**. Subsequent admin export confirmed the product/variant ID, SKU, `Visible=No`, `Stock=0`, $14.06 preview price, and **no changes to any of 8 pre-existing products**.
- **Important SKU mismatch:** despite the original supplier title mentioning *N8*, the selectable supplier option was `N4`. This old, hidden, zero-stock trial entry must **not** be published or treated as an N8 board.
- Second test batch generated via Doroppu and passed independent MAKHEX import validator (**2 products / 2 variants, hidden, stock 0, no media and no checkout**). Squarespace confirmed **`Import Complete — IMPORTED (2)`** and the Products UI displayed **11 products** total.
- Stronger manufacturer-referenced AliExpress candidates used for batch 2:
  - ESP32-C6 DevKitC-1 N8: https://www.aliexpress.com/item/1005005087160183.html, exact selectable N8 option; read-only API stock snapshot 114; USD unit cost $12.50.
  - ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1 N8R8: https://www.aliexpress.com/item/3256803793464226.html, exact selectable N8R8 option; read-only API stock snapshot 108; USD unit cost $22.00.
  - Provisional preview prices at 1.7× unit cost: $21.25 / $37.40. **Shipping, fees and landed margin unverified.**
- Device session timed out while triggering the second *post-import export*. Therefore the full, per-variant readback for the two new items and unchanged-original-product comparison are **still pending**, despite the successful import result and 11-product admin listing. Do not mark full acceptance until completed.

### Remaining MAKHEX catalog sourcing
All **12 existing MAKHEX research-part categories** have AliExpress item candidates; an earlier API audit found **67 supplier variants**. A curated, *not-uploaded* 12-item single-variant research batch has been independently validated for CSV shape, hidden status and zero stock.

Three technical **HOLD** categories require further investigation before catalog import: ESP32-S3 camera board (mixed camera/accessory bundles), 2.9-inch e-paper (controller and package unverified), USB-C breadboard power kit (included power module and safety unverified). The other seven non-board categories remain REVIEW, not supplier-qualified. No automatic fulfillment has been tested.

### Acceptance checklist
- [x] Use account-downloaded official Squarespace **28-column v3** template, not obsolete 26-column v2.
- [x] Identify real Squarespace Store Page slug as `support`. Blank page slug was **rejected** by live import as “Product page not found”; do not assume it creates a new Store Page.
- [x] Generate from authorized AliExpress item/SKU data; retain exact supplier variant IDs, cost and provenance **only in ignored local evidence**.
- [x] Check current pre-import Squarespace product export for SKU/handle collisions.
- [x] Test a single hidden zero-stock import; verify 8→9 and full readback.
- [x] Import two stronger manufacturer-referenced N8/N8R8 trial products with zero stock, no images, no sale price; Squarespace confirmation says 2 imported and 9→11 items in UI.
- [x] Download fresh post-import Squarespace export (`products_Oct-22_04-24-16PM.csv`) and verify exactly **11 products**, the two new SKUs/price/visibility/stock, and all nine previously existing products unchanged across all 34 exported columns. Squarespace export leaves `Product ID [Non Editable]` and `Variant ID [Non Editable]` blank for all rows, so those IDs cannot be asserted from CSV; verify via UI/API if needed.
- [x] Correct the **N4-backed, N8-titled** original hidden trial listing before any public use.
- [x] Commit, CI-test and merge the Doroppu and MAKHEX **v3 format upgrades**, independent validator updates, and documented blank Store Page failure ([Doroppu #19](https://github.com/polygoku/doroppu/pull/19), [MAKHEX #45](https://github.com/polygoku/makhex/pull/45)).
- [ ] Qualify technical hardware variants against vendor schematics/BOM, actual availability at checkout, shipping price/time, returns, image rights and landed economics.
- [ ] Review three HOLD categories; do **not** upload the research-only 12-part batch or enable MAKHEX `storePath` purchase links yet.
- [ ] End-to-end Squarespace order → Doroppu supplier fulfillment → tracking/refund test, only for approved SKUs.

**Safety:** Keep zero stock and Hidden on all imported test items. No secrets, OAuth tokens or buyer data should be added to this issue.


### 2026-10-22 safety regression merged
- [x] [PR #49](https://github.com/polygoku/makhex/pull/49) merged (`cdf1cf6`): QA verifies checkout approvals ledger empty and C6 buyer-orderability/shipping false. XPS `npm run check`, `npm run build`, `npm run qa` and updated staged-catalog assertion passed.
- [x] Live Squarespace old trial title and description corrected to explicitly identify the supplier-selected **N4** and prohibit sale; hidden and stock zero preserved.


### 2026-10-22 direct Squarespace correction — VERIFIED
- Signed-in Squarespace Products editor on XPS: renamed `mkx-1005009494694247` from `ESP32-C6 DevKitC-1 N8 Development Board - Supplier Candidate` to `ESP32-C6 DevKitC-1 N4 - Unverified Supplier Trial (Not For Sale)`; replaced misleading N8 description with N4-vs-N8 warning and no-publish/no-fulfill instructions. Saved using **Save as Hidden**, not Publish.
- Fresh authenticated export `products_Oct-22_08-47-01PM.csv`: **22** rows. Exact comparison against `products_Oct-22_07-38-45PM.csv` finds **2 changed cells only** (Title, Description for this one item). Stock remains `0`, `Visible=No`, retail $14.06, merchant SKU unchanged. Correct separate N8 item `mkx-1005005087160183` remains stock 0, hidden, price $31.25.
- N4 labeling blocker resolved. Supplier verification and checkout-release gates still open.

comments.text:
**2026-10-22 follow-up:** The obsolete Squarespace 26-column CSV format has been corrected in reviewable PRs: [Doroppu #19](https://github.com/polygoku/doroppu/pull/19) and [MAKHEX #45](https://github.com/polygoku/makhex/pull/45). Both PRs add/validate the account's actual **28-column v3 format** with blank GTIN/MPN; CI is in progress.

A separate **public** check from a connected basement computer confirms HTTP 200 / valid TLS for the MAKHEX apex and Squarespace shop, and HTTP **404** for direct public product URLs for the new C6 N8 and S3 N8R8 research candidates. This is consistent with the hidden test import; it does **not** replace the required post-import admin CSV readback of SKU, stock and visibility.

XPS remote agent stopped responding during the final export, so the 11-product export and old-product diff are pending. Do not publish or upload additional candidate batches before that verification.

comments.text:
## XPS restored — second import post-import acceptance **PASS** (October 22, 2026, 4:24 PM Eastern)

The authenticated Squarespace admin successfully exported **`products_Oct-22_04-24-16PM.csv`** (11 rows, 34 columns). A complete field-by-field comparison with the pre-import export **`products_Oct-22_09-51-44AM.csv`** (9 rows) yielded **zero changes across all 34 fields of all nine previously existing products**. Both new rows match the intended item identity and merchant SKUs:

| Item | SKU | Price | Visible | Stock | On sale | Product Page |
|---|---|---:|---|---:|---|---|
| AliExpress 1005005087160183, C6 N8 | `MKX-1005005087160183-0BC421159CCA` | $21.25 | No | 0 | No | `support` |
| AliExpress 3256803793464226, S3 N8R8 | `MKX-3256803793464226-4E4BEABD4C98` | $37.40 | No | 0 | No | `support` |

Both retain blank GTIN/MPN and image URL fields. Squarespace's product-export defaults the inactive sale price to `0.00` (even though staging CSV left it blank) and typographically converts the title's ASCII dash to an em dash. These are non-material platform normalizations; release protections **remain intact**. Squarespace exports blank `Product ID [Non Editable]` and `Variant ID [Non Editable]` even for existing products, so those internal IDs cannot be evidenced by this CSV, and should only be claimed after a verified admin/API ID readback.

Independent URL tests from XPS: `makhex.com` 200, `www.makhex.com` 200 (one canonical redirect), `shop.makhex.com` 200, and all three `/support/mkx-...` hidden test product URLs **404** (valid TLS). No public buyable test listing identified.

**Important remaining HOLD:** first trial `MKX-1005009494694247-CF4EC8776BE9` remains titled N8 but exact selected AliExpress source option is `3:201010228#N4`. It is still **Visible No / Stock 0**; correct or archive the misleading title before eventual public availability. Attempts to target the row interactively were blocked by the XPS's foreground/locked-desktop restriction, so no unsafe edit was made. The entire other 12-part research batch is **not** uploaded. Shipping, actual purchase orderability, electronics-specific hardware confirmation, media rights, and fulfillment are still unverified.

The CSV acceptance checkbox is completed. Keep the overall issue open for the **N4 correction, supplier qualification, and end-to-end ordering** gates.

comments.text:
### MAKHEX bulk supplier import + public sourcing map — 2026-10-22

**Catalog accepted:** Squarespace importer reported **IMPORTED (10)** for ten newly matched AliExpress component listings (11 selected variants). Post-import export `products_Oct-22_05-06-00PM.csv` shows **21 products and 22 variants**, with **zero changes to the preceding 11 variants**, zero SKU mismatches, and all newly imported variants hidden / stock 0 / no active sale. The earlier S3 N8R8 and C6 N8 boards were reused without duplication; original N4-under-N8 trial remains hidden and requires correction before release.

**Project matching:** Ten MAKHEX projects now map 29 BOM lines / 31 component units to 11 reused component types; the twelfth catalog item is a standalone ESP32-C6 DevKit. Each BOM and product page shows an AliExpress research link, technical REVIEW/HOLD status, and no live checkout. [MAKHEX PR #46](https://github.com/polygoku/makhex/pull/46) was merged and production-deployed; direct HTTP smoke tests passed for `/sourcing.json`, the RGB project BOM and product page with disabled checkout.

**Doroppu SKU bindings:** [Doroppu PR #20](https://github.com/polygoku/doroppu/pull/20) merged with passing CI. A private staging registry on XPS reconciled **12 AliExpress item IDs / 13 exact source variants** to the actual Squarespace CSV SKUs and prices; seven tests passed. No AliExpress product orders, fulfillment routing, or inventory synchronization are enabled.

**Freight qualification — blocked:** Owner-authorized, read-only API experiments produced **0 valid shipping quotes**. Legacy `aliexpress.logistics.buyer.freight.calculate` for all 12 products returned `queryShippingOptionForItemforBuyer return null` or `skuId is need`. Adding source-variant attribute strings as `sku_id` produced `UnsupportedParamMapping`; the newer `aliexpress.logistics.buyer.freight.get` returned `InvalidParameter`. This does not establish US postage, checkout orderability or landed margins. The short-lived probe URLs were *inactive Cloudflare version previews*, authorization guarded and automatically expired; local bearer tokens removed. No provider orders or customer data used.

Remaining: confirm API's exact numeric/attribute SKU identity and US freight to ZIP 11021, validate 3 hardware HOLD categories, acquire authorized images, fix the older N4-titled-as-N8 test entry, provision Squarespace Orders/Inventory integration with idempotent Doroppu order mapping, and pass one controlled tracking/refund test before enabling a sellable SKU. Overall issue stays **open**.

comments.text:
### Sprint 16 presentation release — LIVE and verified, October 22, 2026

[MAKHEX PR #47](https://github.com/polygoku/makhex/pull/47) is **merged** (commit `1e4a76d`) and deployed to the live Cloudflare Worker `makhex` (version `00bb9d67-0e15-43a1-9f16-c9ccb848329f`). Public smoke tests returned HTTP 200 for the shop, selected individual products, project BOM pages, `/sourcing.json`, and the untouched Squarespace shop. Production content assertions passed.

The redesigned [MAKHEX Components catalog](https://makhex.com/shop/) now presents:
- All **12 component types / 13 selected AliExpress variants**, exact source-match model names and **indicative** retail prices (planning snapshot 2026-10-22), not a live sale offer.
- Original distinctive technical hardware illustrations, explicitly labeled **not exact supplier product photography**. Supplier images were not copied without permission.
- 3 technical HOLD labels, checkout **disabled for all 12**; Squarespace records remain hidden with zero stock.
- All 10 [project BOMs](https://makhex.com/projects/) list indicative per-line and parts-only subtotal, excluding freight, taxes and unresolved parts. Hardware gaps surfaced for speaker, physical pushbutton and rated 5V WS2812 power/possible shifter.
- Agent-consumable [sourcing JSON v2](https://makhex.com/sourcing.json) maps models, prices, project parts, REVIEW/HOLD gates. No private supplier wholesale costs or SKUs.
- Existing local discussions and original project creator credits preserved.

**Automated and visual QA:** PR GitHub CI passed; merged-build QA passed 30 HTML pages, 12 gated products, 10 native discussions, zero checkout paths; Cloudflare dry-run passed with `--keep-vars`; Edge/CDP checked mobile 390px, tablet 768px and desktop 1440px, no horizontal overflow; production content assertions PASS.

**Outstanding separate revenue-release gates:** authorized variant-specific AliExpress freight to U.S. ZIP 11021 (0 usable quotes so far), supplier real order/fulfillment/track/refund idempotency through Doroppu and Squarespace Orders API, sample verification and permissioned product photography, 3 hardware HOLD source specifics, original hidden N4-vs-N8 misnamed test entry. Do not enable purchasing until those checks pass. Sprint 16 **presentation** is complete; first-sellable-product qualification is NOT complete.
